module: "hitPole" stunt zone type: a pole (delineator vehicle, config vehicles/delineator/pole.pc) is spawned at pos, with a race marker above it; the player scores points by hitting it while drifting. The module returns a constructor called by gameplay_drift_stuntZones.setStuntZones; it is not an extension. Emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished with the sub-hook onHitPoleAccomplished (angle, speed, hitPole base points).
notes: The collision is read from map.objects[vehId].objectCollisions of the drift vehicle; the point is awarded on the frame the collision appears (hitPole true and lastFrameHitPole false) and only if the player is drifting (detectStunt is called by the manager).

Once accomplished, the pole is no longer available (available = false) until reset(); the reset physically puts the pole back in place (requestReset, resetBrokenFlexMesh) and recreates the marker after 0.1 s.
If the pole is destroyed, the zone removes itself via gameplay_drift_stuntZones.clearStuntZone.
Fallback values for UI tests: angle 50°, speed 30.

C.desc: hitPole zone. Fields: data = {id, zoneData = {pos}}, marker (race marker), activeData = {veh (pole), hitPole, lastFrameHitPole, available, resetFlag}.

clear.desc: Removes the pole vehicle and its marker.

clearMarker.desc: Removes the race marker if it exists.

createMarker.desc: Creates an "overhead" race marker (radius 5) 2.5 m above the pole.

resetData.desc: Resets activeData (available = true, no collision), losing the reference to the pole.

reset.desc: Puts the pole back in place (physics and mesh reset), reinitializes the data, then recreates the marker after 0.1 s via a job.

init.desc: Internal constructor: stores the data, spawns the delineator pole (pole.pc) at zoneData.pos without making the player enter it, creates the marker.

accomplish.desc: Success: removes the marker, makes the zone unavailable and emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished (sub-hook onHitPoleAccomplished).

detectStunt.desc: Called when the player drifts: calls accomplish if the pole was just hit.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: updates the marker, stores the previous collision state and detects a collision between the drift vehicle and the pole.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: If the destroyed vehicle is the pole, forgets the pole and removes the zone from the manager.

isAvailable.desc: Returns whether the pole can still earn points.

returns.desc: true as long as it has not been hit.
